scope: Disposable isolated localhost proof with synthetic non-sensitive identities and records only; this is compatibility evidence, not an authority certificate.

checks.atomicApplyWrites: pass: failing two-write batch rolled back its valid create
checks.wrongKeyAndSpace: pass: exact DpopKeyMismatch, InvalidCredential, and InvalidDelegationToken rejections
checks.mailboxLexiconValidation: not attempted: alpha writes used validate=false
checks.narrowOAuthGrant: not attempted: synthetic account credential used
checks.staleCompareAndSwap: fail: the alpha lexicons expose no write precondition and the reference PDS accepted a stale swapRecord field while overwriting the newer record

limitations.production: Real member mail remains on unchanged Stalwart authority; the upstream alpha explicitly excludes production and sensitive data.
limitations.mutableState: The current Comail mailbox contract requires provider-enforced compare-and-swap; client-side read/check/write is not an acceptable substitute.
limitations.oauth: The local protocol probe used the synthetic account legacy access JWT to request delegation tokens; narrow interactive OAuth scope proof and a reusable writer-repo lifecycle remain required.
limitations.schema: Writes used validate=false because the unpublished email.atmos mailbox lexicons were not installed in the disposable PDS; mailbox-schema validation remains required.
limitations.durability: The alpha has no security-review, backup, stable-schema, or non-destructive-upgrade guarantee.
